en: A playful kitten that follows you around.

en: A loyal puppy that guards your farm.

en: A soft lamb that produces fine wool.

en: A graceful deer with magical herbs.

en: A clever little fox that brings luck.

en: A wise owl with feathers of wisdom.

en: Mixed feed for chickens, ducks, rabbits and grazing animals.

en: Sweet treats that make animals happy.

en: Brush your animals to keep them clean.

en: Collect milk from adult cows. Keep the pail in your backpack or use it beside a cow.

en: Each animal has its own personality! Take good care of them, and they will reward you with gifts and products.

en: You need more space for animals. Build a coop, barn, or animal house!
